what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Ecuador in all host countries combined: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 122060 asylum seekers from Ecuador.
The United States hosts the largest share, 93.1%, followed by Italy, Spain and Mexico.

why.text: UCDP records an interstate armed conflict between Ecuador and Peru in 1995.
The fact pack records no armed conflict in Ecuador in recent years, so it does not say why the number of asylum seekers grew.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2000 at 270 asylum seekers.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2023 to 2025, and the figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals of asylum seekers summed over every host country; refugees from Ecuador are counted separately.
